'''Grand Admiral Tsung fun with fighters''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 24 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HB Tsung LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

yep, prolly a deck type everybody's seen before, but its prolly better than my last decks. Trying not to use Ep.1 cards

== Strategy ==

-First Draw Roche using your Obj. because it is central to one form of your retreival, Slayn and Korpil Facilities.  Your other source is the minimal from Virtual Luke.

-Keep chewie and Han together aboard Independance to add battle Destiny.

-if there are any really tough starfighters(bounty hunter ships)  Use X-wing Cannons and Steady Aim together and blow them away.

-hit as many ships as possible as it will retreive you two more for your use...

-If they refuse to come and fight, drain all the the life force out of those cowards
